Entry thesis (nine quarters ago) is fully falsified on profitability: margins went 15% -> 10% -> NEGATIVE; the company sells product below cost. Revenue growth has also stalled (+11% and decelerating; the brand line is being rationalized). Auditor/going-concern language is on the record and the filings are late.
recent_developments: Formal going-concern disclosure; annual report late with a filed extension notice; exchange non-compliance notices outstanding.
Covenant breach on the credit facility at FY-end; cash down to ~22 against a ~-339 adjusted-EBITDA year.
Management pivots: exiting private-label, cutting brand SKUs, seeking to sell a plant, 'exploring strategic alternatives' (widely read as seeking a buyer or rescue capital).
The plant-based frozen category is in outright decline; peers have filed for bankruptcy protection this year.
Any financing at this market cap would be massively dilutive; bankruptcy of the equity is an explicitly discussed scenario in sell-side and press coverage.
